{{Top|leg}}
'''Arne Marson''' was an individual who worked as a [[Speeder truck/Legends|repulsortruck]] driver on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, Marson over-turned his truck in the entertainment district of Coruscant while drunk, causing his cargo of [[Stratt/Legends|Stratts]] to spill out and escape. Marson subsequently covered up the incident and hoped that the problems caused by the crash would go away.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
